reviewMethod: Assistant inspected original person, actual garment, model conditioning, raw generated images and saved final candidates on 13 October 2026. This is a qualitative review, not a calibrated metric.

observations: The actual conditioning image retains the uploaded teal and cream stripes.
The raw model output is a beige/grey speckled garment with an invented asymmetric neckline; uploaded colors and stripes are absent.
The existing stripe-loss guard correctly rejected it and no final candidate was published.
This is a native neural garment-fidelity failure, not a compositing failure; acceptance for the reported input remains unmet.
The brown jersey, contrast sleeves and V neckline transfer to the original studio person with plausible shoulder, sleeve and hem placement.
The source beige top is no longer visibly exposed in the inspected image.
The large 95 graphic acquires duplicated enclosed loops and severely distorted digit shapes, already present in the raw output; lettering is also degraded.
Small speckled artifacts remain around the side/underarm edges. Garment fidelity is insufficient for acceptance despite improved fitting.
The black Rhude graphic transfers, but the uploaded short-sleeved T-shirt becomes a sleeveless top matching the source vest silhouette.
Both raw and final images lack sleeves; the original replacement mask does not open enough upper-arm space.
White source-clothing slivers remain at the shoulders and there are rough neckline/armhole boundaries in the final composite.
The saved raw output cannot be repaired into a sleeved shirt solely by compositing because the model did not synthesize sleeves.
The studio person appears in the uploaded black graphic T-shirt with plausible round neckline, shoulders, both sleeves and hem.
The main color and large graphic are recognizable; no large beige-shirt fragments are visible in the inspected final image.
Face, hair, hands, jeans and background appear preserved; the separate pixel audit tests preservation against saved semantic masks.
Small text and print details are degraded, with residual roughness at underarm/side boundaries. This single candidate does not validate production-quality fitting or arbitrary shirts.
